title: VirtualCompanyWorkflow
description: Code-driven + visual-node local multi-agent orchestration contract. Reference philosophies: Haaziq386/Agent-Orchestration (React Flow canvas + FastAPI engine, parallel scheduling), akudo7/kudosflow (config-as-JSON, canvas edits only overwrite workflow.json), gabriel-eidelman/agent-flow-visualization (WebSocket live stream of agent thinking / tool calls / shell logs).

tickIntervalSec.description: V2 Tick heartbeat interval (ResourceManager/TickDriver). 0.5s default; 1s also fine.

agents.description: Agent (virtual employee) registry. Each agent declares role boundaries so tasks cannot cross roles.

levels.description: Execution hierarchy. Each element = one horizontal row in the React Flow canvas; ALL nodes inside a level execute in parallel, and the renderer pins their Y coordinate to the level index. Downstream level depends on ALL upstream levels completing.

index.description: Row index; must equal the array position and strictly increase by 1

name.description: Row label, e.g. 'L0 Intake', 'L1 Implement', 'L2 QA/Review'

gate.description: Row gate: 'all' = every node must succeed before next row (kudosflow-style barrier); 'any' = quorum row

qa.description: QA/Review node mechanism: error -> console log + red highlight on flow graph + state rollback + auto recovery path.

onFailure.description: Effects that MUST all fire when a QA gate fails. console + redHighlight + rollback are the baseline trio.

targetLevel.description: Level index to roll back to; its nodes re-execute after rollback

keepCheckpoint.description: Preserve execution checkpoint so rolled-back row re-runs instead of full restart

notifyProgress.description: Also register the rollback event into progress.md

providers.description: Optional provider registry (local Ollama / Codex CLI / Claude). Nodes reference a provider + model; missing defaults fall back to config.yaml.

oneOf.description: 旧形式（向后兼容）：部门 id 列表 [{id,title}]，无继承机制。
Phase 2b 部门实体化：key = 部门 id。支持 head/tools/boundaries/template；员工继承部门 tools（并集）与 boundaries（合并收紧）；template 引用预设模板，引擎加载时解包注入运行态。

departments.description: V2: 全局部门注册表。旧数组形式（id 列表）与新实体字典形式（head/tools/boundaries/template）均可；Agent.department 引用部门 id，小队横抽按部门取人。

squads.description: V2: 敏捷小队注册表。kind=squad 的节点引用 squad id 触发横抽：从各部门临时抽调成员（可带工具覆盖，如 UI 调文生图/视频），共享 SquadRoom 会议室状态，子任务完成后自动解散归建。

members.description: 抽调名单：每项 from = 部门 id（或具体 agent id），as = 小队内角色，agent = 可选指定具体员工，toolsOverride = 小队内临时加挂的工具

from.description: 部门 id；validator 会解析成该部门下的 agent（可配 agent 指定到人）

agent.description: 直接指定 agent id（优先于 from 部门解析）

toolsOverride.description: 该成员在小队内临时可用的工具（如 agnes-ai-image / agnes-ai-video）

dissolveOn.description: 解散条件：squad_qa_pass = 小队 QA 子任务通过即自动解散归建

datastore.description: V2: 持久化数据基座接口层（本地 JSON 起步，预留 BaaS 切换）。引擎核心只依赖 StorageDriver 接口。

collections.description: 启用哪些持久化面板：HR 招聘池 / 员工成长值 / 踩坑知识库（哈希链不可篡改）

git_policy.description: V2 (Phase 3a): Git 分支隔离与 PR 门禁。三道防线之第一道（引擎权威层）= Python 子进程/模拟；第二道 = 仓库分发的 git hooks（防人绕过）；第三道 = CI 红灯回流。

backend.description: simulated=影子仓库内存 diff（Phase 2 过渡，零外部依赖）；subprocess=asyncio 子进程真 git；hooks=git hooks 第二道；ci=远端 CI 门禁

repoPath.description: 被管理的本地仓库路径；缺省=projectRoot

checkScripts.description: pr_gate 节点并行执行的门禁脚本（如 ['python -m pytest backend/tests/', 'node scripts/dump-snapshot.mjs']）。任一 exit≠0 = 红灯 = 拦截打回

Agent.description: A virtual employee: role, provider/model, tool permissions, prompt contract, and hard boundaries (no role crossing).

provider.description: Which backend executes this agent ('mock' = deterministic local stub for offline prototyping & testing)

tools.description: Whitelist of tools this agent may use. Empty array = pure text-only agent. Phase 2b: 'compiler' = 编译/构建类工具（模板标配），与 'terminal' 并列。

workspace.description: Sandbox path this agent may touch

department.description: V2: department id from the top-level departments registry (e.g. 'pm', 'ui', 'dev', 'qa', 'ops'). Squads 横向抽调按部门取人。

departmentRole.description: V2: title within the department, e.g. 'Senior Frontend Engineer'.

stamina.description: V2: 体力资源（游戏化外壳）。max = 体力上限；regenPerMin = 每分钟回复量。窗口余量不足时 ResourceManager 强制该 agent RESTING。

boundaries.description: Role boundary contract — what this agent MUST NOT do (prevents task crossing / 逻辑混乱).

requiresHumanApproval.description: Actions needing 主人 sign-off, e.g. ['rm -rf', 'git push']

outputs.description: Named output artifacts this agent must produce; QA gates check these.

Node.description: A DAG node = one subtask assigned to one agent. Same level = same row = parallel.

label.description: Human label rendered on the canvas node

agent.description: Agent id from the agents registry

kind.description: qa/review nodes execute the QA/Review mechanism; gate is a pure barrier; squad (V2) triggers the 敏捷小队横抽 mechanism — node declares the squad id, engine assembles PM+Dev+QA from departments, runs them on a shared SquadRoom state, auto-dissolves on subtask completion; pr_gate (V2) opens PRs for upstream dev branches and runs the merge gate (conflict + check scripts) — any red = 拦截打回

squad.description: V2: for kind=squad — the squad id from the top-level squads registry that this node instantiates.

branch.description: V2 (git_policy): isolated branch this dev node commits to. Default = node id. 禁止多 agent 直改主干文件——每个 Dev 只在 <branch> 上开发。

gate.description: V2: checks this node enforces. pr_gate nodes run the full merge gate: conflict dry-run + git_policy.checkScripts. Any red → pr_rejected + 红框回退三件套。

task.description: The concrete subtask prompt (what to do, expected outputs)

dependsOn.description: Optional intra-level soft dependencies (row is still parallel; edges are visual only, row gate remains the hard barrier)

toolOverrides.description: Per-node tool whitelist override (intersection with agent.tools)

tokenBudget.description: V2: 工位负载数据源。estimate = 本任务预估 Token 总量（工位案卷高度 / 资源调度权重）；缺省时加载器由 TokenEstimator 启发式补全。

estimate.description: 预估总 Token 量（~42000 = 42k tok）

reviewCriteria.description: For kind=qa/review: acceptance criteria the reviewer agent checks

onError.description: Per-node error policy; baseline is the global qa.onFailure trio (console + redHighlight + rollback).

Department.description: Phase 2b 部门实体：从字符串标签升级为真实组织实体。员工继承部门 tools（并集）+ boundaries（合并收紧）。

head.description: 部门负责人（Department Head）的 Agent ID；Org Chart 的中间层节点

tools.description: 部门专属工具库：该部门所有员工自动继承（与员工个人 tools 取并集）

boundaries.description: 部门级安全约束（只读 / 禁外网等）：与员工个人 boundaries 合并，mustNot 取并集（只收紧不放权）

template.description: 引用的预设模板 ID（如 'agile_dev_squad'），引擎加载时解包注入运行态

Provider.description: Local-first provider endpoint registry (Ollama / Codex / Claude / builtin).

apiKeyEnv.description: Env var name holding the key; key itself never stored in workflow.json

rate.description: V2: provider-level rate limit (API 冷却即强制休息的配额来源)。windows 支持多窗口（分钟级 + 小时级）；任一窗口触底 → 该 provider 名下 agent 全 RESTING。

windows.description: 限速窗口列表，如 [{limit:160, periodSec:60}, {limit:1500, periodSec:18000}]

limit.description: 窗口内允许的最大请求/Token 数

cooldownSec.description: 触限后额外强制冷却秒数（咖啡厅小坐）
